question: How many beings are in each retinue and what is their condition?
premises: Each one has countless crores in his own retinue.
They are freed from the impurity of maya.
They are established only in mere office.
inference: The retinues are vast, purified of maya, yet still defined by limited office.
uncertainties: The compound parārdhakoṭayo@saṃkhyāḥ is read as an immeasurable number.
plain_english: Each of them has countless crores in his own retinue. They are freed from the impurity of maya, yet established only in the function of their office.
